result.title: RDT-3D: Resolution-Decoupled Training for High-Fidelity 3D Geometry Generation
result.summary: High-fidelity 3D geometry generation requires maintaining global structural coherence alongside fine-grained surface details. While recent coarse-to-fine frameworks leverage Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE) to condition local queries, we reveal a critical training-inference resolution discrepancy: coordinate guidance and geometric supervision are aligned during training, whereas inference decodes high-resolution geometry from coarse spatial coordinates. This mismatch introduces a severe distribution shift that degrades fine details. To overcome this, we propose Resolution-Decoupled Training (RDT), which anchors RoPE guidance at 512 resolution while supervising geometry at 1536, enabling robust detail extrapolation. Additionally, to eliminate high-resolution data bottlenecks, we present Dual3D-300K, a large-scale paired dataset comprising 300K watertight 3D point clouds explicitly aligned across 512 and 1536 resolutions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RDT substantially improves sharp geometric regions, while Dual3D-300K offers a scalable benchmark for high-resolution 3D generation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文面向高保真 3D 几何生成，指出粗到细框架中训练时坐标引导与几何监督对齐、而推理时却由粗坐标解码高分辨率几何的训练—推理分辨率错配，提出将 RoPE 引导锚定在 512、监督放在 1536 的解耦训练方案，并构建 512/1536 对齐的 30 万点云数据集。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「位置编码引导的锚定尺度与监督尺度分离」可作为一种具体线索，供核查位置/RoPE 结构如何影响 latent 推理状态的分辨率与长度外推，但与 VLM 推理本身无直接关系，需人工判断可迁移性。
